questions.q: The management has decided to appoint an 'English teacher' to improve the communication skills of the newly recruited staff in the corporate office.
questions.s: Mains Level Slang Error! 'English teacher' ka literal matlab hota hai 'A teacher from England'. Subject padhane wale ke liye grammatically correct phrase **'A teacher of English'** hota hai.

questions.q: The judge acquitted the accused with a stern warning, asking him to stay away from all criminal activities for 'justice's sake'.
o: with a stern warning, asking him
to stay away from all criminal activities
questions.s: Apostrophe Pronunciation Rule! Jab kisi word ke end mein 'hissing sound' (s/ce/sh) aaye (jaise Justice, Conscience, Goodness) aur uske baad 'sake' likha ho, toh sirf apostrophe (') lagta hai, 's' nahi. Sahi: **'justice' sake'**.

questions.q: The naval ship was intercepted by the heavily armed coast guard when it mistakenly entered the 'international water' during the routine patrolling exercise.
o: by the heavily armed coast guard
the international water during the routine
questions.s: Meaning Change Concept! 'Water' (liquid) uncountable hai. Lekin jab hum Samundar ya Ocean borders ki baat karte hain, toh hamesha **'Waters'** use hota hai. Sahi phrase: 'International waters'.

questions.q: Despite being born into a family of illiterate merchants, he grew up to become a 'man of letter' and published several acclaimed novels.
o: he grew up to become a man of letter
questions.s: Idiomatic Plural! 'Letter' ka matlab akshar hota hai. Par 'Vidwan' ya 'Literature ke gyani' insaan ko hamesha **'Man of letters'** kaha jata hai.

questions.q: The aggressive defense lawyer argued that his client should be granted bail immediately on the 'ground' of his deteriorating mental and physical health.
o: that his client should be granted bail
immediately on the ground of his
questions.s: Contextual Noun! 'Ground' ka matlab zameen hota hai. Lekin jab iska matlab 'Karan' ya 'Reason' ho (on the basis of), toh ye hamesha plural **'Grounds'** likha jata hai. 'On the grounds of' sahi hoga.

questions.q: After the sensational mutiny in the army camp, several 'court-martials' were conducted simultaneously to punish the guilty soldiers without delay.
o: to punish the guilty soldiers without delay
questions.s: Compound Noun Plural! 'Court-martial' (sainik adalat) mein main word 'Court' hai, 'Martial' adjective hai. Toh plural main word ka banega: **'Courts-martial'**.

questions.q: The prestigious government hospital has inaugurated a new ward entirely dedicated to the comprehensive treatment of patients suffering from 'lungs cancer'.
o: entirely dedicated to the comprehensive treatment
of patients suffering from lungs cancer
questions.s: Noun as Adjective Rule! Yahan 'Lung' word 'Cancer' (Noun) ke liye Adjective ka kaam kar raha hai. Adjective kabhi plural nahi hota. **'Lung cancer'** aur **'Eye surgery'** sahi forms hain.

questions.q: The eccentric billionaire booked a luxurious 'suit of rooms' in the five-star hotel for his extended family during their week-long vacation in Dubai.
o: in the five-star hotel for his extended family
during their week-long vacation in Dubai
questions.s: Specific Collective Noun! Rooms ke group/set ko 'Suit' (pehnne wala kapda) nahi kehte. Sahi spelling aur word **'Suite'** hota hai ('Suite of rooms').

questions.q: The ancient king was deeply worried about the succession to the throne because he had 'no issues' to inherit his vast and prosperous empire.
o: The ancient king was deeply worried
about the succession to the throne
because he had no issues to inherit
questions.s: Vocabulary Nuance! Jab 'Issue' ka matlab 'bachha' (offspring) ho, toh wo Uncountable ki tarah singular form mein rehta hai. 'He had **no issue**' sahi hoga. ('Issues' ka matlab topics/mudde ho jata hai).

questions.q: Please send a 'words' to the branch manager that the regional director will be visiting the zonal office tomorrow morning for a sudden inspection.
o: the regional director will be visiting
questions.s: Fixed Phrase! Jab 'Word' ka matlab 'Message/Sandesh' ho, toh wo singular rehta hai aur bina article ke aata hai. 'Send word' (sandesh bhejna) sahi phrase hai.

questions.q: The delicate 'crockeries' imported from China were completely shattered due to the extremely careless handling by the delivery boys at the warehouse.
o: imported from China were completely shattered
due to the extremely careless handling
by the delivery boys at the warehouse
questions.s: Uncountable Group Noun! Machinery, Stationery ki tarah **'Crockery'** (bartan) bhi uncountable hai. Iska plural 'Crockeries' kabhi nahi banta.

questions.q: Approximately 'three-fourths of the land' in this arid region 'have' been rendered barren due to the continuous lack of rainfall over the decades.
o: in this arid region have been
rendered barren due to the continuous
lack of rainfall over the decades
questions.s: Fraction Rule Trick! Fraction (3/4th) ke baad agar Uncountable Noun (Land) aaye, toh verb hamesha Singular hoti hai. 'Land... **has** been' aayega. (Agar countable noun hota toh plural aati).

questions.q: The Indian economy is currently standing at a crucial 'crossroad', where one wrong policy decision could lead to a massive and prolonged recession.
o: where one wrong policy decision could
lead to a massive and prolonged recession
questions.s: Always 'S' Noun! Chaurahe ko English mein hamesha **'Crossroads'** (with 's') likha jata hai, chahe wo singular (a crossroads) ki tarah use ho raha ho.

questions.q: The police interrogated the prime suspect for hours, but they could not extract any reliable information regarding the 'whereabout' of the stolen artifacts.
o: The police interrogated the prime suspect
for hours, but they could not extract
the whereabout of the stolen artifacts
questions.s: Fixed Plural Form! Kisi ke thikane ya location ko hamesha **'Whereabouts'** kaha jata hai ('s' ke saath). 'Whereabout' galat word hai.

questions.q: The imported electronic gadgets were immediately seized at the airport because the corrupt businessman had failed to pay the necessary 'custom duty'.
o: were immediately seized at the airport
because the corrupt businessman had failed
to pay the necessary custom duty
questions.s: Meaning Difference! 'Custom' ka matlab rivaaz (tradition) hota hai. Import/Export par lagne wale tax ko hamesha **'Customs'** (with s) kaha jata hai. Sahi: 'Customs duty'.

questions.q: The factory workers went on a massive and violent strike demanding that their 'wage' be increased in accordance with the rising inflation in the country.
o: The factory workers went on a
that their wage be increased in accordance
with the rising inflation in the country
questions.s: Wage Dual Meaning! Jab 'Wage' ka matlab saza (biblical) ho toh singular hota hai. Par jab iska matlab dihadi/salary (Daily pay) ho, toh ye hamesha plural **'Wages'** likha jata hai aur plural verb leta hai.

questions.q: The furious passenger demanded a full refund from the airlines after his 'two-hours journey' was delayed multiple times due to sudden technical snags.
o: The furious passenger demanded a full refund
two-hours journey was delayed multiple times
questions.s: Hyphenated Adjective Concept! Yahan 'Two-hour' word 'Journey' (Noun) ke liye Adjective ban gaya hai. Isliye isme 's' nahi lagega. **'Two-hour journey'** sahi hoga.

questions.q: In the highly patriarchal society of that historical era, the 'heir-at-laws' were given the absolute and unquestionable right to claim the ancestral property.
o: and unquestionable right to claim the ancestral property
questions.s: Prepositional Compound Plural! Jab Compound Noun prepositions se juda ho (at, in, of), toh plural hamesha pehle/main word ka banta hai. Sahi: **'Heirs-at-law'**.

questions.q: The strict dietician advised the obese patient to consume a balanced diet strictly comprising fresh 'fruit and vegetable' every morning without fail.
o: The strict dietician advised the obese patient
to consume a balanced diet strictly
questions.s: Contextual Plural! 'Fruit' singular rehta hai agar ek hi type ka ho. Par jab diet/grocery context mein varieties ki baat ho, toh humesha **'Fruits and vegetables'** (dono plural) use kiya jata hai.

questions.q: The muscular blacksmith used a heavy pair of 'pincer' to hold the glowing red iron rod over the blazing fire in his workshop.
o: a heavy pair of pincer to hold
the glowing red iron rod over
the blazing fire in his workshop
questions.s: Always Plural Instruments! Do parts wale tools (Scissors, Tongs, Pincers) hamesha 's' ke saath likhe jaate hain, chahe 'a pair of' laga ho ya na laga ho. Sahi word: **'Pincers'** (chimta).

questions.q: The rebellious soldiers strictly refused to follow the 'Commander's-in-chief orders' during the ongoing border skirmish, leading to a massive controversy.
questions.s: Compound Noun Possession! Plural banana ho toh 'Commanders-in-chief' hota hai. Par jab *Apostrophe 's'* (possession/kiska order) lagana हो, toh wo hamesha end mein lagta hai: **'Commander-in-chief's orders'**.

questions.q: Despite having multiple advanced degrees from reputed universities, his 'knowledges' regarding practical life situations was astonishingly poor.
questions.s: Basic Uncountable! 'Knowledge' (gyaan) hamesha uncountable hota hai. Iska plural 'Knowledges' English dictionary mein exist nahi karta.

questions.q: The recent technological advancements in Artificial Intelligence possess the terrifying capability to either elevate or completely destroy 'the mankinds'.
o: in Artificial Intelligence possess the terrifying
questions.s: Universal Noun! 'Mankind' (manav jati) pehle se hi poori humanity ko cover karta hai. Isme kabhi 's' nahi lagta aur iske pehle 'The' article bhi nahi aata. Sirf **'Mankind'** aayega.

questions.q: Thousands of 'protester' gathered near the historic national monument to violently voice their dissent against the newly passed agricultural laws.
o: gathered near the historic national monument
against the newly passed agricultural laws
questions.s: Quantity Noun Rule! 'Hundreds of', 'Thousands of', 'Millions of' ke baad aane wala noun hamesha *Plural Countable* hota hai. 'Thousands of **protesters**' sahi hoga.

questions.q: The renowned motivational speaker emphasized that 'sympathies' and 'kindnesses' are the two most essential virtues required to build a peaceful global society.
o: the two most essential virtues required
to build a peaceful global society
questions.s: Abstract Noun Restriction! Feelings aur emotions (Sympathy, Kindness, Honesty, Bravery) Abstract Nouns hote hain aur inka plural form nahi banaya jata general context mein. Sahi: **'Sympathy and kindness are...'**
